svg.title: CantiniAutoGPS
svg.desc: Geotag your photos from a GPS track: photos are matched by time to a GPX track and get a location pin.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Geotag your photos from a GPS track.
Match capture time to your GPX file. No account, no cloud.
